scene: Atop the ladder, three scenic travel routes fan out before you.
picture: A flat side view along the breezy ridge. Far left sits a lakeside dock with a waiting glass-bottomed boat. Left of centre, the boy in his orange vest and kite clings to the tall ladder. Up high centre, a colourful hot-air balloon floats moored. Far right, a winter sleigh tram waits on frosty tracks.
shown: A moored glass-bottomed boat waiting at a lakeside dock on the far left
A tethered hot-air balloon with a wicker basket floating up high centre
A wooden sleigh tram idling along a frosty track on the far right
